# Bloomwire

> Handcrafted pipe cleaner flowers from Jaipur, India. Each bloom is hand-sculpted by local artisans from premium velvet chenille stems. Everlasting flowers that never fade.

Bloomwire is a Jaipur-based studio founded in 2026 by Somil Sharma. We craft everlasting pipe cleaner (chenille stem) flower arrangements — bouquets, keychains, potted decor, and DIY kits. Each flower is individually hand-sculpted by local artisans. Our flowers last for years with zero watering or maintenance.

## Shipping & Returns
- Free shipping on orders above ₹500
- ₹49 flat shipping below ₹500
- Dispatch in 5-7 business days (handmade to order)
- All orders prepaid (UPI, Credit/Debit Card) — no COD
- 7-day return window for transit damage
- 12-hour cancellation window
- All sales final except transit damage

## Payment
- UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm)
- Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay)
- No Cash on Delivery

## Rewards Program (Petals)
- Earn 5% back in Petals on every order (1 Petal = ₹1)
- Daily check-in bonuses
- Tier rewards: Bloom Buddy (200 Petals), Petal Collector (300), Bloom VIP (500), Bloomwire Elite (1000)
- Petals expire in 12 months
- Redeem Petals for free products with qualifying orders

## Social Impact
- 2% of every order donated to Dog Home Foundation, Jodhpur
- Caring for 800+ stray dogs
